id-20260926-news-3.title: Regent of Gowa Named Suspect in Alleged Licensing Extortion, Assets Worth Rp5.58 Billion Seized

segments.src: Korps Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi (Kortas Tipidkor) Polri menetapkan Bupati Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, sebagai tersangka dalam perkara dugaan pemerasan, gratifikasi, dan tindak pidana pencucian uang (TPPU).
segments.tr: The Indonesian National Police's Anti-Corruption and Criminal Investigation Corps (Kortas Tipidkor) has named the Regent of Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, as a suspect in a case of alleged extortion, gratuities, and money laundering (TPPU).

segments.src: Penetapan itu diumumkan penyidik dalam konferensi pers di Gedung Bareskrim Polri, Jakarta Selatan, Jumat (25/9/2026).
segments.tr: The designation was announced by investigators in a press conference at the Bareskrim Polri Building, South Jakarta, Friday (9/25/2026).

segments.src: Perkara ini mencakup empat rangkaian peristiwa yang diduga terjadi sepanjang 2025 hingga 2026 dan berkaitan dengan pengurusan izin di Kabupaten Gowa, Sulawesi Selatan.
segments.tr: This case encompasses four series of events that allegedly occurred throughout 2025 to 2026 and are related to licensing procedures in Gowa Regency, South Sulawesi.

segments.src: Hingga kini, semua uraian di bawah masih berstatus dugaan yang disampaikan penyidik dan belum diuji di pengadilan.
segments.tr: To date, all descriptions below remain alleged statements presented by investigators and have not been tested in court.

segments.src: ## Empat Rangkaian Dugaan
segments.tr: ## Four Series of Allegations

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan penyidik Kortas Tipidkor Polri, empat rangkaian dugaan tersebut adalah sebagai berikut.
segments.tr: Based on statements from the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor investigators, the four series of allegations are as follows.

segments.src: 1. **Pungutan pada pengurusan PKKPR.** Dalam pengurusan Persetujuan Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang (PKKPR), pengembang perumahan diduga diminta menyetor uang sekitar Rp1 juta hingga Rp1,5 juta untuk setiap unit rumah. Penyidik menyebut permintaan itu disampaikan melalui pejabat dinas terkait.
segments.tr: 1. **Levies on PKKPR processing.** In the processing of Space Utilization Activity Conformity Approval (PKKPR), housing developers were allegedly asked to deposit around Rp1 million to Rp1.5 million for each housing unit. Investigators stated that the request was conveyed through related departmental officials.

segments.src: 2. **Dana CSR gerai minimarket.** Penyidik menduga permintaan dana kepada Indomaret dilakukan dengan dalih tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan (CSR) sebesar Rp85 juta untuk setiap pembukaan gerai baru. Permintaan tersebut diduga disampaikan melalui seorang orang kepercayaan berinisial HA.
segments.tr: 2. **Mini-market outlet CSR funds.** Investigators suspect that the request for funds from Indomaret was carried out under the guise of corporate social responsibility (CSR) amounting to Rp85 million for each new outlet opening. This request was allegedly conveyed through a confidant with the initials HA.

segments.src: 3. **Diskon 70 persen rumah mewah.** Dalam pengurusan Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung (PBG) Perumahan Royal Spring, tersangka diduga meminta satu unit rumah senilai Rp1,4 miliar dengan potongan harga 70 persen sebagai syarat persetujuan.
segments.tr: 3. **70 percent discount on luxury houses.** In processing the Building Approval (PBG) for Royal Spring Housing, the suspect allegedly requested one house valued at Rp1.4 billion with a 70 percent price cut as a condition of approval.

segments.src: 4. **Dana sponsor pembukaan gerai.** Tersangka diduga meminta dana sponsor Rp100 juta kepada Indomaret untuk pembukaan gerai di kawasan Beautiful Malino.
segments.tr: 4. **Outlet opening sponsorship funds.** The suspect allegedly requested Rp100 million in sponsorship funds from Indomaret for the opening of an outlet in the Beautiful Malino area.

segments.src: ## Kaitan dengan Pengadaan Ambulans
segments.tr: ## Connection to Ambulance Procurement

segments.src: Penyidik juga menelusuri asal dana yang diduga dipakai untuk membayar rumah berdiskon tersebut.
segments.tr: Investigators are also tracing the origin of the funds allegedly used to pay for the discounted house.

segments.src: Menurut keterangan penyidik, dana itu diduga berasal dari imbalan (kickback) proyek pengadaan enam unit ambulans Dinas Kesehatan Gowa senilai Rp3,8 miliar yang dikerjakan PT API.
segments.tr: According to investigator statements, these funds are suspected to come from kickbacks on the procurement project for six Gowa Health Office ambulances worth Rp3.8 billion undertaken by PT API.

segments.src: Dugaan ini masih dalam pendalaman, termasuk aliran dananya.
segments.tr: This allegation is still under investigation, including the flow of funds.

segments.src: ## Aset Senilai Rp5,58 Miliar Disita
segments.tr: ## Assets Worth Rp5.58 Billion Seized

segments.src: Dalam penyidikan, Polri menyita aset yang diduga terkait perkara ini dengan total nilai sekitar Rp5,58 miliar.
segments.tr: During the investigation, the police seized assets allegedly related to this case with a total value of approximately Rp5.58 billion.

segments.src: Aset tersebut terdiri atas:
segments.tr: These assets consist of:

segments.src: | Aset | Perkiraan nilai |
segments.tr: | Asset | Estimated value |

segments.src: | Rumah di kawasan Royal Spring, Kabupaten Gowa | Rp1,4 miliar |
segments.tr: | House in the Royal Spring area, Gowa Regency | Rp1.4 billion |

segments.src: | Rumah di kawasan Waterfront, Makassar | Rp3,5 miliar |
segments.tr: | House in the Waterfront area, Makassar | Rp3.5 billion |

segments.src: | Satu unit Toyota HiAce keluaran 2025 | sekitar Rp682 juta |
segments.tr: | One unit of 2025 Toyota HiAce | approximately Rp682 million |

segments.src: Penyidik menyebut telah memeriksa puluhan saksi dan ahli serta melakukan penggeledahan di sejumlah lokasi sebelum menetapkan tersangka.
segments.tr: Investigators stated they had examined dozens of witnesses and experts as well as conducted searches at several locations before naming the suspect.

segments.src: ## Belum Ditahan, Pemeriksaan Menyusul
segments.tr: ## Not Yet Detained, Examination to Follow

segments.src: Sampai saat ini Sitti Husniah belum ditahan.
segments.tr: Until now, Sitti Husniah has not been detained.

segments.src: Penyidik menyatakan akan memanggil dan memeriksanya sebagai tersangka dalam waktu dekat.
segments.tr: Investigators stated they will summon and examine her as a suspect in the near future.

segments.src: Keputusan soal penahanan akan dinilai setelah pemeriksaan tersebut.
segments.tr: The decision regarding detention will be assessed after the examination.

segments.src: ## Polri: Tidak Ada Intervensi
segments.tr: ## Police: No Intervention

segments.src: Sitti Husniah diketahui merupakan adik mantan Astamaops Polri, Komjen (Purn) Fadil Imran.
segments.tr: Sitti Husniah is known to be the younger sister of former National Police Astamaops, Comr. Gen. (Ret.) Fadil Imran.

segments.src: Menanggapi hal itu, Direktur Penindakan Kortas Tipidkor Polri, Brigjen Robertus Yohanes De Deo, menegaskan bahwa hubungan keluarga tersebut tidak berpengaruh pada penanganan perkara.
segments.tr: Responding to this, the Director of Enforcement for the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor, Brig. Gen. Robertus Yohanes De Deo, emphasized that this family relationship has no effect on the handling of the case.

segments.src: Ia menyatakan tidak ada intervensi dalam proses penyidikan.
segments.tr: He stated there is no intervention in the investigative process.

segments.src: Pemberitaan sejumlah media juga menyebut Fadil Imran dan keluarga memilih tidak mencampuri proses hukum yang berjalan.
segments.tr: Reports from several media outlets also mention that Fadil Imran and his family chose not to interfere with the ongoing legal process.

segments.src: ## Asas Praduga Tak Bersalah
segments.tr: ## Presumption of Innocence

segments.src: Penetapan tersangka merupakan tahap awal dalam proses hukum, bukan putusan bersalah.
segments.tr: The naming of a suspect is an early stage in the legal process, not a verdict of guilt.

segments.src: Sitti Husniah berhak mendapat pembelaan dan dianggap tidak bersalah sampai ada putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: Sitti Husniah has the right to defense and is considered innocent until there is a court decision with permanent legal force.

segments.src: Perkembangan perkara, termasuk pemeriksaan tersangka dan pasal yang akhirnya didakwakan, akan bergantung pada hasil penyidikan dan proses peradilan.
segments.tr: The development of the case, including the examination of the suspect and the articles ultimately charged, will depend on the results of the investigation and the judicial process.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Menjadi Sorotan
segments.tr: ## Why This Case Has Become a Spotlight

segments.src: Perkara ini menyangkut layanan perizinan, yaitu pintu masuk bagi pengembang dan pelaku usaha yang ingin berinvestasi di daerah.
segments.tr: This case concerns licensing services, which are the gateway for developers and business actors wanting to invest in the region.

segments.src: Bila dugaan pungutan di luar ketentuan terbukti, biaya tambahan semacam itu berpotensi ikut membebani harga rumah dan iklim usaha setempat.
segments.tr: If the allegations of unauthorized levies are proven, such additional costs have the potential to burden house prices and the local business climate.

segments.src: Publik kini menunggu kelanjutan penyidikan, pemeriksaan tersangka, dan keterbukaan aparat dalam menjelaskan perkembangan perkara.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting the continuation of the investigation, the examination of the suspect, and the transparency of authorities in explaining the development of the case.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan keterangan resmi Kortas Tipidkor Polri yang dilaporkan sejumlah media nasional pada 25 September 2026.
segments.tr: *This article was prepared based on official statements from the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor reported by several national media outlets on September 25, 2026.

segments.src: Informasi dapat berubah seiring perkembangan penyidikan.*
segments.tr: Information is subject to change as the investigation develops.*
